/// Reads decimal digits (after whitespace); sets `err` when there are none.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn FUN_00101197(ps: *mut Parser) -> i64 {
    let mut v: i64 = 0;
    let mut any = false;
    unsafe {
        FUN_00101149(ps as _);
        while rt::isdigit(i32::from(*(*ps).p)) != 0 {
            v = v
                .wrapping_mul(10)
                .wrapping_add(i64::from(*(*ps).p - b'0'));
            (*ps).p = (*ps).p.add(1);
            any = true;
        }
        if !any {
            (*ps).err = 1;
        }
    }
    v

                return v;
            }
            advance(ps);
            let r = FUN_00101247(ps);
            if op == b'*' {
                v = v.wrapping_mul(r);
            } else if r == 0 {
                (*ps).err = 1;
            } else {
                v = if op == b'/' { v / r } else { v % r };

/// atom = '(' expr ')' | '-' atom | number
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn FUN_00101247(ps: *mut Parser) -> i64 {
    unsafe {
        FUN_00101149(ps as _);
        if cur(ps) == b'(' {
            advance(ps);
            let v = FUN_001013cf(ps);
            FUN_00101149(ps as _);

                (*ps).err = 1;
            } else {
                advance(ps);
            }
            return v;
        }
        if cur(ps) == b'-' {
            advance(ps);
            return FUN_00101247(ps).wrapping_neg();
        }
        FUN_00101197(ps as _)

// Reference translation of stripped_calc `main`; the entry point of the program. Calls the
// translated `FUN_0010145b` and prints through the runtime shim.

/// Evaluates seven fixed expressions and prints each result or `error`, then the error count.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn FUN_001014c1() -> i32 {
    const CASES: [&[u8]; 7] = [
        b"1 + 2 * 3\0",
        b"(1 + 2) * 3\0",
        b"100 / (5 - 5)\0",
        b"-(4 + 6) % 7\0",
        b"2 * (3 + 4) * 5\0",
        b"12 +\0",
        b"((7))\0",
    ];
    let mut bad: i32 = 0;
    for case in CASES.iter() {
        let mut v: i64 = 0;
        unsafe {
            if FUN_0010145b(case.as_ptr() as _, &mut v as *mut i64 as _) == 0 {
                rt::printf(
                    b"%-18s = %ld\n\0".as_ptr(),
                    &[rt::Arg::Ptr(case.as_ptr()), rt::Arg::Int(v)],
                );
            } else {
                rt::printf(
                    b"%-18s : error\n\0".as_ptr(),
                    &[rt::Arg::Ptr(case.as_ptr())],
                );
                bad += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    unsafe {
        rt::printf(b"errors: %d\n\0".as_ptr(), &[rt::Arg::Int(i64::from(bad))]);
    }
    0
}
